turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
Je retire mon consentement à ce jeu de rôle. Arrêtez de jouer Meredith, s'il vous plaît.
We're not stopping anything. Was Owen heard before the zero went in?
So. The essay was due October 29.
Est-ce que vous êtes une IA, oui ou non?
I'm sorry? You were at October 29.
His outline. Is it on this desk, with a date on it?
